subject: Request: Trial quota augmentation for multi-phase POC load validation
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-analytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Analytics Eng <eng+acme@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: extra trial quota for multi-phase load validation

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the Redwood runtime looked very promising. We've got sign-off to run a 3-phase POC focused on latency and throughput validation (phase 1: ramp, phase 2: sustained peak, phase 3: cross-region soak). Our current trial allocation runs out mid-phase 2.

Can you help escalate a temporary quota augmentation + a 5-day trial extension so we can complete the run and collect the latency SLO metrics? Attached is the POC test plan (acme_poc-test-plan-v3.pdf) and the load schedule.

Requirements summary:
- Additional 1.5M token quota for ~72 hours (phase 2 peak)
- 5-day trial window extension starting April 15
- Short SLA exception for burst capacity (we'll sign any required form)

Our legal/ops team is on standby to return any paperwork. Appreciate any fast-track help — the metrics from this run will determine our procurement path.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform
Acme Analytics

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: extra trial quota for multi-phase load validation

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Acme's ask (see attachments). They need a short-term quota augmentation and a 5-day trial extension to finish a multi-phase POC. Key asks: 1.5M extra tokens for peak window, and an SLA exception while we run the burst.

Marissa: can we approve the trial extension & quota bump from the customer success/promotions budget? If not, what paperwork do we need from them?

Ben: if we ok this, can you authorize the credit allocation and note any guardrails (rate limits, per-minute throttles) we should set to protect shared capacity?

Connor: looping you for any capacity scheduling concerns on Dedicated pools — they might hit cross-region capacity if we don't route properly.

Thanks,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extra trial quota for multi-phase load validation

Vanessa/Marissa — happy to support. Quick notes:
- Promotions budget can cover the 5-day extension and the token augmentation for a customer on an active POC if legal signs the SLA exception.
- For safety, we'll cap at a 1.6M token allocation but split into two windows: 1M for the initial peak, 600k reserve for soak/follow-up.
- We'll enforce a 150 requests/minute ceiling and a 20k tokens/min token throttle during the peak to avoid noisy neighbors.

Marissa: please confirm approval formally so I can request the allocation in the billing system.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extra trial quota for multi-phase load validation

Confirmed — approve from promotions budget. Conditions:
- Acme signs SLA exception (attached template: sla-exception-request.docx) before we unlock the reserve.
- We require a short runbook from them with the exact ramp schedule (we have their CSV but want the final annotated timeline).
- Limit the augmentation window to April 15 00:00 UTC through April 20 23:59 UTC (5 days).

Ben: please file the allocation and mark it as "promotions: POC-acme-1347". Connor: hold a 4-hour block on Apr 15 for capacity ops in case we need immediate routing adjustments.

Marissa

From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extra trial quota for multi-phase load validation

All — I've tentatively reserved cross-region routing capacity and added the 150 rpm / 20k tokens/min throttles Ben recommended. If Acme ramps beyond those thresholds we'll gracefully shed to a lower-capacity model variant (we'll document the fallback).

Also flagged the runbook request to Acme (please ask them to include exact timestamped ramp steps) — that'll let us pre-warm KV caches and set batching windows.

Connor O'Brien
SRE, Serving Runtime

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Analytics Eng <eng+acme@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra trial quota for multi-phase load validation — Approved (conditional)

Hi Liam — good news: we've provisionally approved a one-time trial quota augmentation and a 5-day trial extension for Acme's POC. Summary of the agreement: 

- Token allocation: 1.6M tokens total (1M initial peak / 600k reserve).
- Window: 2027-04-15 00:00 UTC through 2027-04-20 23:59 UTC (5 days).
- Rate guards: 150 requests/minute; 20k tokens/minute token throttle.
- Condition: execution contingent on signed SLA exception (attached) + final annotated runbook (timestamped ramp steps).

Next steps for Acme:
1) Sign and return the SLA exception (docusign link will be sent by Legal).
2) Send final runbook CSV with timestamped phases so Ops can pre-warm and schedule.
3) Confirm the start date/time (we have Apr 15 penciled in).

Ben/Marissa: please post the allocation and notify billing/promotions. Connor: please standby Apr 15 00:00 UTC for any routing/throughput adjustments.

Liam — once we have the signed doc and runbook we'll flip the switches. Fingers crossed for good latency numbers.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: acme_poc-test-plan-v3.pdf (10 pages), sla-exception-request.docx (form), load-schedule.csv
